hero.titulo: Just ask. Your agent does it.
hero.descripcion: An AI assistant that works inside your accounts and your systems. You talk to it in your own words, and it goes in and does the work for you. No tabs, no apps, no platforms, no forms. For people and for companies.

brainSwap.cartaAria: Interchangeable model: the AI model switches between Claude, ChatGPT, and open source models without rebuilding the agent. Active model: {{label}}.
brainSwap.subtitulo: Switch the model that powers the agent, without rebuilding anything.

integracion.descripcion: No migrations or months-long projects. You connect your account or your system once, and from then on you just talk to the agent.

paso1.descripcion: You sign in yourself in a secure browser, like always. On a computer the connection is direct and your password never goes through us; on a phone it travels encrypted through our infrastructure and is never stored.

paso2.descripcion: In plain language, the way you would tell a person.

paso3.descripcion: It goes into your account and gets the work done. You approve any important action.

personal.usuario1: How much have I spent on my card this month?
personal.agente1: I checked your bank account: you are at $12,480 this month. Your biggest expense was groceries, at $3,120.
personal.usuario2: Book me a table for two on Friday at 8.
personal.agenteBeta1: Booking tables is in beta: I'm still learning it. Very soon I'll be able to make this reservation for you.
personal.usuario3: And buy me headphones at the best price.
personal.agenteBeta2: Buying at the best price is in beta. Once it's ready, I'll compare options and ask for your confirmation before any payment.

ventas.usuario1: Give me the sales analysis for the last quarter.
ventas.agente1: The stockout in the star category (12 days without inventory) and lower traffic after the promotion. Without that stockout, October would have closed at ~$2.1M.
ventas.usuario3: And the projection for next quarter?
ventas.agente2: I project $7.4M (95% interval: $6.9M to $7.9M). The biggest risk is still inventory in the star category.

facturacion.usuario1: Process this invoice and validate it.
facturacion.agente1: Yes: same supplier and amount as invoice A-1182 from June 3. I recommend not paying A-1207 until it's confirmed. Should I flag it for review?
facturacion.agente2: Done. Invoice A-1207 was flagged for review and I notified the payments lead.

operaciones.agente1: I reviewed today's payments and found something that needs your attention.
operaciones.agente2: Hold the second payment (invoice A-1207) until it's cleared up with the supplier. I already prepared the clarification note. Should I send it?
operaciones.agente3: Done. I held the payment and sent the clarification. I'll let you know as soon as the supplier responds.

customerSuccess.usuario1: Where can I check the status of my order?
customerSuccess.agente1: Your order is on its way and arrives tomorrow. Here is the tracking number and the order details.
customerSuccess.usuario2: Can I change the delivery address?
customerSuccess.agente2: Of course. I updated the address to your new branch and the carrier has already confirmed it.
customerSuccess.agente3: Happy to help. Anything else I can do for you?

checks.posibleDuplicado: Possible duplicate: invoice A-1182 on Jun 3

alerta.detalle: Aceros del Norte invoiced PO OC-4471 twice (invoices A-1182 and A-1207). Double payment risk: $48,200.

primitivas.titulo: The infrastructure a model doesn't give you
primitivas.descripcion: An LLM reasons, but it doesn't isolate customers, control access, leave an auditable trail, or connect to your systems. That's what the platform provides: a reusable layer that supports any provider and that you don't rebuild when you switch.

modeloIntercambiable.descripcion: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or open source models with your own key (BYOK). The provider is switched through configuration; the agent, its tools, and its integrations remain intact.

aislamientoMultiTenant.descripcion: Each customer operates in an isolated environment, with their own data, credentials, and settings. No crossover between accounts, and your information is never used to train models.

controlAcceso.descripcion: Users, permissions, and workspaces per area. Access is granted by invitation and by role, under the principle of least privilege.

credencialesRevocables.descripcion: Each integration uses its own credential, with limited scope and immediate revocation. You grant or withdraw access without affecting the rest of the system.

trazabilidad.descripcion: Every run is logged: input, context, model, and response. An auditable history of what the agent did, when, and with which data.

integracionNativa.descripcion: The agent operates inside your systems (ERP, CRM, email, data) through connected tools. It works where your team already is, not in a separate interface.

apruebasLoQueImporta.descripcion: Nothing that spends your money or is irreversible runs without your confirmation. You see exactly what the agent is about to do, and you decide.

ejemplos.introDestacado: For your business, the same agent works inside your systems: ERP, CRM, email.
ejemplos.introResto: Accounts payable, quotations, support, or whatever process your operation needs.

ap.tagline: Processes and validates invoices without manual data entry
ap.descripcion: It reads every invoice, extracts the data, and validates it against your ERP and your rules. It detects duplicates and errors before they get paid. You close faster and without manual data entry.

quotations.descripcion: It applies your prices, margins, and business rules instantly. What used to take hours of back and forth is done in minutes, without calculation errors.

cs.descripcion: It responds with your business context and access to your systems, 24/7. It doesn't just answer: it updates orders, looks up data, and escalates to your team only when needed.

ejemplos.otroProcesoDestacado: The same platform adapts to any process in your operation:
ejemplos.otroProcesoResto: reconciliations, onboarding, reports, document generation, whatever you need. You describe the process; we build it and deploy it.
ejemplos.sdkNota: Have a technical team? The same agent can also be embedded in your site or your app with our SDK.

comoFunciona.titulo: From your process to an agent in production
comoFunciona.descripcion: No months-long projects. The platform is already built; we configure and integrate the agent tailored to your operation.

paso1.titulo: You tell us about your process
paso1.descripcion: You tell us what you want to automate: accounts payable, quotations, support, or whatever flow your operation needs. We identify where an agent adds the most value.

paso2.descripcion: We set up the agent on our platform, with the model you choose (BYOK), and connect it to your systems. Since the infrastructure is already in place, you have it in weeks, not months.

paso3.titulo: It stays running in your business
paso3.descripcion: The agent works inside your systems, executing real work. We fine-tune it and add new agents as your operation grows.

ctaFinal.descripcion: Create your account, connect your accounts and your systems, and start asking. For your everyday life and for your business.

footer.descripcion: An AI assistant that works inside your accounts and your systems. You talk to it in your own words, and it does the work. For people and for companies.

gate.descripcion: Triggers let an external event fire your agents through a webhook URL. They are available on the Pro and Business plans.

reveal.secretoHint: Sign each request with this secret. It is not stored in plain text and is not shown again.

sitios.subtitulo: Connect sites where you sign in yourself so your agents can work inside your account.

gate.descripcion: With a plan with autonomy you can connect sites where you sign in yourself, in a secure browser, and let your agents work there. On a computer the connection is direct and your password never goes through Ledesma; on a phone it travels encrypted through our infrastructure and is never stored.

conectar.label: Site URL
conectar.urlInvalida: Paste a valid URL (for example https://app.yoursite.com/login).
conectar.fallo: We could not open the secure browser for {{dominio}}. Try connecting it again in a few minutes.

modal.instruccion: Sign in here just like you normally would. Nobody else sees your data.

relayMovil.divulgacion: On your phone, what you type here travels encrypted to Ledesma's infrastructure, where it is decrypted to be forwarded to the secure browser you sign in to. It is never stored or logged. From a computer, the connection is direct to the secure browser and does not pass through us.

noLeible.detalle: We could not read {{campo}} on the site to check it. Nothing was done.

sinEfecto.detalle: The task made progress, but we could not confirm that the final step took effect on the site. A draft or a half-finished state may remain. Check the site before asking for it again.

bloqueoReintentos.titulo: The final step could not be confirmed
bloqueoReintentos.detalle: The task made progress, but the system stopped retrying the final step to avoid repeating it by accident. A draft or a half-finished state may remain on the site. Check it before asking again.

topeExcedido.detalle: The amount of {{monto}} is over your limit of {{tope}}. Nothing was done. You can change your limit in Settings.

configuracion.descripcion: Sending, paying, buying or deleting cannot be taken back. Before doing one, your assistant compares what you asked for with what is on the screen; if they do not match, it stops and tells you. Set your limits here, once.
configuracion.permitirDescripcion: If you turn this off, your assistant will never do them: it will only tell you what it found.
configuracion.topeDescripcion: If an action involves more than this amount, it stops and tells you. At 0, no action involving money happens on its own.
